<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$root = __DIR__ . '/repo';
require $root . '/tests/bootstrap.php';

$classes = [
    Componenta\DI\ProxyFactory::class => 'src/ProxyFactory.php',
    Componenta\DI\Container::class => 'src/Container.php',
    Componenta\DI\ContainerFactory::class => 'src/ContainerFactory.php',
    Componenta\DI\Exception\ResolutionException::class => 'src/Exception/ResolutionException.php',
    Componenta\DI\Tests\Support\ContainerBuilder::class => 'tests/Support/ContainerBuilder.php',
];
$observed = ['php' => PHP_VERSION, 'root' => $root, 'classes' => [], 'functions' => []];
foreach ($classes as $class => $relative) {
    $path = (new ReflectionClass($class))->getFileName();
    if ($path === false || realpath($path) !== realpath($root . '/' . $relative)) {
        throw new LogicException('Unexpected loaded class origin: ' . $class);
    }
    $observed['classes'][$class] = ['path' => $path, 'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $path)];
}
foreach (get_defined_functions()['user'] as $function) {
    if (!str_starts_with($function, 'componenta\\di\\internal\\') && $function !== 'componenta\\di\\tests\\support\\container') {
        continue;
    }
    $path = (new ReflectionFunction($function))->getFileName();
    $relative = $function === 'componenta\\di\\tests\\support\\container' ? 'tests/Support/functions.php' : 'src/Internal/functions.php';
    if ($path === false || realpath($path) !== realpath($root . '/' . $relative)) {
        throw new LogicException('Unexpected loaded function origin: ' . $function);
    }
    $observed['functions'][$function] = ['path' => $path, 'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $path)];
}
if (count($observed['functions']) !== 7) {
    throw new LogicException('Expected six internal functions and the local container test helper.');
}
$destination = getenv('D1_ORIGIN_REPORT');
if ($destination === false || $destination === '') {
    throw new LogicException('Set D1_ORIGIN_REPORT for isolated verification.');
}
file_put_contents($destination, json_encode($observed, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) . "\n");

import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = base / 'repo'
phase = sys.argv[1]
directory = base / 'evidence' / phase
directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
test = 'tests/Contract/NativeLazyEligibilityContractTest.php'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def snapshot():
    return {str(p.relative_to(repo)): sha(p) for p in sorted((repo / 'src').rglob('*.php'))}

def run(version):
    php = f'/workspace/scratch/8f6c1df8ef3b/runtime/php{version}/php'
    prefix = directory / f'php{version}'
    command = [php, '-d', 'opcache.enable_cli=0', 'vendor/bin/pest', test,
               '--bootstrap', str(base / 'origin-bootstrap.php'), '--compact', '--colors=never',
               '--do-not-cache-result', '--order-by=default', '--log-junit', str(prefix) + '.xml']
    environment = dict(os.environ, D1_ORIGIN_REPORT=str(prefix) + '-origin.json')
    before = snapshot()
    started = time.time()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, env=environment, capture_output=True)
    output = result.stdout + result.stderr
    log = Path(str(prefix) + '.log')
    log.write_bytes(output)
    junit = Path(str(prefix) + '.xml')
    document = ET.parse(junit).getroot() if junit.exists() else None
    suite = document.find('testsuite') if document is not None else None
    row = {'phase': phase, 'php': version, 'command': command, 'cwd': str(repo),
           'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=repo, text=True).strip(),
           'exit_code': result.returncode, 'seconds': time.time() - started,
           'test_sha256': sha(repo / test), 'before': before, 'after': snapshot(),
           'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': sha(log), 'output': output.decode(),
           'origin': json.loads(Path(environment['D1_ORIGIN_REPORT']).read_text()) if Path(environment['D1_ORIGIN_REPORT']).exists() else None,
           'junit': dict(suite.attrib) if suite is not None else None,
           'failures': [{'name': case.get('name'), 'message': failure.get('message'), 'text': failure.text}
                        for case in document.findall('.//testcase') for failure in list(case.findall('failure')) + list(case.findall('error'))] if document is not None else []}
    Path(str(prefix) + '.json').write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=2) + '\n')
    return {'php': version, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'seconds': row['seconds'], 'junit': row['junit'],
            'failure_count': len(row['failures']), 'tail': row['output'][-2200:],
            'source_unchanged': before == row['after'], 'origin_verified': row['origin'] is not None}

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
    for row in executor.map(run, ['84', '85']):
        print(json.dumps(row, indent=2))
